scientific_limitations: This result classifies only the displayed characteristic-three two-parameter smooth family, its rank-drop divisor, and its two special cuspidal boundary members; no global discriminant singularities or all bielliptic genus-four curves are classified.
title: A rank-jumping divisor and cuspidal boundary in a characteristic-three net of genus-four bielliptic curves
